description: Brand voice checker — Check marketing or product copy against your brand voice guidelines: score 0-100 with verdict ON_BRAND / MINOR_ISSUES / OFF_BRAND, the tone detected, each violation (exact quote, the rule it breaks, a better wording, and whether the quote really appears in the text), strengths and a full on-brand rewrite. Offline style stats: words, sentences, average sentence length, exclamation marks, ALL-CAPS words, buzzwords found, you/we counts. Params: text (up to 6,000 characters), optional guidelines (default: clear, friendly, confident, plain English, no jargon or hype), brand. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: e.g. Our revolutionary, best-in-class platform leverages cutting-edge synergy to empower your workflow!!! Sign up NOW.

name: ai_brand_voice
